lesson: Lattice samples of zeta'/zeta on Re s = 1 (or on Re s = 1 - theta with a shifted multiplier) are Fourier coefficients of the periodised prime measure: any identity built from poles of a finite Euler factor on the test side is the explicit formula for a non-compactly supported test, regularised. The only inequality step is the classical zero-free region; it is false for DH but true for the height-shift twist, so it does not separate the controls. The sqrt(p) in Corollary B1 came from a worst-case profile estimate, not from zeta.
